notes: Version 3.3 corrects one attribution to the Foundation paper: the admissibility axioms A1-A3 do not force irreducibility and non-commutation. Under a representation-theoretic dictionary, they give them only under an additional sector reading of A3, not derived, on which a generator-stable decomposition of the fibre counts as premature selection (Foundation version 2.6, Lemma 5.6). No other statement is changed; the results of the paper are unchanged.
